axes.description: Identifies the kind of producer that created a quality fact.

terms.description: A model-driven coding or review agent.
A repeatable machine sensor or analyzer.
A named human assertion.
A value imported from a legacy or external contract.
The producer kind is not known from retained evidence.

axes.description: Describes evidence coverage without implying an assessment or decision.

terms.description: Required evidence was available.
Some required evidence was unavailable or omitted.
Required evidence was unavailable.

axes.description: Describes what retained evidence establishes for a subject or aspect.

terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance.
The evidence establishes a concern without decisive failure.
The evidence establishes non-conformance.
The evidence does not support a conclusive assessment.
The assessment does not apply to this subject.
No assessment was attempted.

axes.description: Describes a comparison between before and after states.

terms.description: The observed quality changed for the better.
The observed quality changed for the worse.
The comparison contains both improvements and regressions.
The compared quality is materially unchanged.
No quality-relevant delta was observed.
The evidence cannot establish a direction of change.

axes.description: Records a versioned policy disposition separately from assessment.

terms.description: Policy permits the operation or result.
Policy permits continuation with a warning.
Policy prevents continuation.
Policy defers a disposition pending more evidence or authority.

axes.description: Orders the impact of a finding; scoring weights remain policy-owned.

terms.description: Immediate, broad, or irreversible impact.
Material correctness, security, or operational impact.
Significant but bounded impact.
Limited impact or risk.
Informational improvement without material defect impact.

axes.description: Describes issue state through lifecycle events, never through observations.

terms.description: The issue requires disposition or remediation.
An authorized actor accepted the issue risk.
An authorized actor waived the applicable requirement.
The reported issue does not represent the claimed defect.
Evidence and policy establish that the issue is resolved.

axes.description: Classifies a typed reference to retained evidence.

terms.description: Source text, range, or symbol evidence.
A test execution result.
A runtime or performance measurement.
Structured or textual output from a tool.
A retained file or generated artifact.
A standard, report, or other document.
A named human statement.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and safe handling of untrusted input.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Exposure and controls at trust boundaries.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: Discipline and focus of a change scope.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: Architectural drift caused by a change.
